description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.loader object responsible for dynamically loading core CKEditor scripts and their dependencies from the _source directory, managing script dependencies, load order, and URL resolution.

methods.name: loadPending
methods.description: Loads the next script in the pending load queue, ensuring scripts are loaded in order.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a specific script and its dependencies asynchronously, managing load order and avoiding duplicate loads.
